selection.ownership: Giphy, Inc. (New York, United States), owned by Shutterstock, Inc. since 2023. The reviewed edition is the public international API at api.giphy.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official GIPHY API authentication (required api_key query), trending/search/get-by-id/categories endpoints, Developer Dashboard key issuance, Shutterstock acquisition (2023), and dated incident search for Giphy/GIPHY security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying platform customer-data compromise found in reviewed coverage. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

Official GIPHY v1 api_key query authentication, trending/search/GIF-by-id/categories paths, New York Giphy Inc / Shutterstock ownership, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. No current unresolved GIPHY platform breach is asserted. This is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck matches the native validator: GET /v1/gifs/trending with limit=1 and official api_key query. Native category is social (Rust CATEGORIES has no design/media bucket).
Returns raw GIPHY JSON under data instead of the upstream {gifs, pagination} wrapper. Optional limit/offset bind to documented query names. Context/bundle/rating filters are omitted.
Caller query maps to documented q. Returns raw GIPHY JSON under data. Optional lang/limit/offset bind to documented query names.
gifId is a URL-encoded path segment (GIF Object id, not random_id). Returns raw GIPHY JSON under data instead of the unwrapped GIF object.
Returns raw GIPHY JSON under data instead of {categories, pagination}.
GET /v1/gifs/translate. Caller s maps to documented s. Returns raw GIPHY JSON under data.
GET /v1/gifs/random. Optional tag and rating bind to documented query names.
GET /v1/gifs?ids=. Caller ids is a comma-separated GIF Object id list.
GET /v1/stickers/search. Caller query maps to documented q.
GET /v1/stickers/trending.
GET /v1/stickers/translate.
GET /v1/stickers/random.
GET /v1/gifs/search/tags. Caller query maps to documented q.
GET /v1/channels/search. Caller query maps to documented q.
GET /v1/tags/related/{term}. term is URL-encoded as a path segment.
GET /v1/trending/searches.
GET /v1/randomid. Returns a privacy-preserving identifier for customer_id.

GET https://giphy-analytics.giphy.com/v2/pingback_simple. Composio random_id maps to documented customer_id. gif_id and analytics_response_payload are sent as query parameters. Empty 200 bodies map to {ok: true}.
GET /v1/gifs/categories/{category_id}. category_id is the encoded category name, not a numeric id.
GET /v1/gifs/categories/{category_id}/{tag} (tagged GIFs). tag is required by the official path even though Composio only lists category_id.
GET https://api.giphy.com/v2/emoji with per-operation baseUrl so the connector http.baseUrl can stay on /v1.
GET https://api.giphy.com/v2/emoji/{gif_id}/variations.
GIPHY has no dedicated random-tag path. This maps GIPHY_TAG_RANDOM to GET /v1/gifs/search/tags with limit=1 and optional q={{tag}}.
POST https://upload.giphy.com/v1/gifs as application/x-www-form-urlencoded with source_image_url. Binary file uploads are omitted; the declarative engine cannot send multipart bodies.
